_about: Intentional mid-air re-jumps, judged from each game's about.json and manual. Keys: '<game>' (every hero in it), '<game>/<file>' or '<game>/<file>/<key scan hex>'. Values: the reason, in plain words.
jump-boots: the jet pack lesson: a tap in the air lifts again, on purpose (level 2 then counts the taps)
kit-moves/hero.chr/48: the lesson about Up: it keeps lifting while held, on purpose
maximus/pod.chr: a pod's Up is thrust, not a jump (a vehicle)
